verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a reasonable thing to ask of a SaaS invoicing product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one. Scheduled sends, recurring invoices and quote-to-invoice conversion are rule-based automation, not an AI assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
